note: Martin County has no countywide zoning (county permitting page). Williamston, Hamilton and Robersonville have zoning ordinances; Williamston and Robersonville publish zoning maps only as PDF/web pages, with no queryable district layer found. The county's only queryable ZONING layer (ParcelWebMapTest and ParcelMapSQLExpress MapServer/5, 65 polygons, ZONE field, last updated 2019) covers only a small part of the county and returned zero districts within 0.25 degrees of the sample point (-77.19555, 35.86510), failing validation (2 attempts).
